objective: Keep the proven Google Photorealistic tile path and stabilize the parcel approach/blend on mobile without reopening local V2.1 geometry or landing UI.
accepted_proof: Cesium ion authorization works in owner browser

mobile_tile_quality: Do not set skipLevelOfDetail=true on mobile if it produces coarse blocky parcel geometry; prefer progressive refinement.
At altitudes below 3000 m, lower maximumScreenSpaceError progressively toward a parcel-quality target instead of keeping a coarse mobile value.
Do not start LOCAL_BLEND until required visible Google tiles around the parcel have refined to the chosen quality threshold or a bounded timeout is reached.
Keep memory bounded; quality may ramp only near the parcel.
blend: Verify ClippingPolygonCollection uses the canonical parcel polygon with the correct interior/exterior orientation.
Prevent Google geometry from rendering through the local twin footprint.
Do not show local GLB at 2500 m. Preload it hidden; reveal only during parcel approach after clipping is confirmed active.
Use a short altitude/distance blend window around the parcel, not a global crossfade.
Ensure no z-fighting or double-ground surface remains after blendComplete=true.
ar_gating: Keep A-F labels hidden until localTwinVisible=true AND blendComplete=true AND camera is inside the local interaction envelope.
Declutter labels after blend using screen-space collision; never show labels over unstable/coarse Google tiles.
token_url_hygiene: On page load, if the URL contains ion=, remove only that query parameter with history.replaceState without reloading.
Use CESIUM_ION_TOKEN from localStorage/runtime only. Never print or serialize it into runtime JSON/receipt.

evidence: one uncut mobile Earth-to-WP27 MP4 from owner-authorized runtime
stop_rule: Do not rebuild V2.1, do not redesign landing, do not search for credentials. Patch mobile Google tile refinement -> verify parcel clipping -> delay local twin reveal -> gate AR -> record -> commit -> receipt.
